mapper.select: SELECT BALANCE_AMT AS balanceAmount, ANNUAL_RATE_PCT AS annualRatePct, MONTHLY_PAYMENT_AMT AS monthlyPaymentAmount FROM USER_LOAN WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND RATE_TYPE_CODE = 'VARIABLE' AND BASE_MONTH = (SELECT MAX(BASE_MONTH) FROM USER_INCOME_MONTH WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) ORDER BY LOAN_ID

SELECT L.LOAN_ID AS loanId, T.LOAN_TYPE_NAME AS loanTypeName, L.ANNUAL_RATE_PCT AS annualRatePct, NVL(L.RATE_TYPE_CODE, 'UNKNOWN') AS rateTypeCode, L.MONTHLY_PAYMENT_AMT AS monthlyPaymentAmount, L.BALANCE_AMT AS balanceAmount FROM USER_LOAN L JOIN DIM_LOAN_TYPE T ON T.LOAN_TYPE_CODE = L.LOAN_TYPE_CODE WHERE L.USER_ID = #{userId} AND L.BASE_MONTH = (SELECT MAX(BASE_MONTH) FROM USER_INCOME_MONTH WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) ORDER BY L.LOAN_ID
SELECT MAX(TOTAL_ASSET_AMT) FROM USER_ASSET_SNAPSHOT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND BASE_MONTH = (SELECT MAX(BASE_MONTH) FROM USER_INCOME_MONTH WHERE USER_ID = #{userId})
SELECT BASE_DATE AS baseDate, RATE_PCT AS ratePct FROM FACT_POLICY_RATE WHERE RATE_NAME = '한국은행 기준금리' ORDER BY BASE_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
